_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With only 5% of 12h windows producing ±2+ point moves over the last week, this is a statistical coil — HOLD is the honest call until VIX breaks below 15 or funding spikes to force the next leg.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst forward-calls HOLD with medium conviction while narrative implies an UP move; the judge sides with the analyst's HOLD based on base-rate evidence and the analyst's higher trust weight (7.67 vs 6.00)
next_move.confirmed_if: VIX breaks below 15 with funding contained under 0.012%, allowing the phase to mature upward toward Anxiety/Complacency
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 20 with funding accelerating past 0.015%, forcing a down-leg back toward Panic
